priority.d0_0900_policy: Preserve CALIBRATION_INSUFFICIENT_DETERMINISTIC and expected HRRR horizon-short UNAVAILABLE. Never substitute an older complete run.

as_of_classes.as_of_rule_gated: Run init plus frozen publication latency, or observation time plus assumed 20 min lag. Verified under Phase 6/7 rules, not measured publication times.
as_of_classes.archive_retrieved_now: Payload bytes downloaded at reconstruction time from Open-Meteo Single Runs or IEM monthly archive.
as_of_classes.post_settlement_market: Kalshi GET /historical/markets after settlement: event identity and bucket labels, not contemporaneous open-book state.
as_of_classes.current_open_unverified_as_of: Current open markets used only when historical settled markets are absent. Not proof of HH:00 listing.
as_of_classes.unverifiable_live_availability: In-window fetch success, live evidence SHA-256, and capture-window prediction_as_of cannot be reconstructed.

limitations: Not a Phase 7 record; never enters the prospective cohort or primary evaluation.
reconstructed_at is reconstruction time, not a capture-window finalization.
Open-Meteo payloads are archive_retrieved_now; in-window bytes are unverifiable.
IEM publication time is assumed_fixed_lag_20m; the monthly archive may differ from the live snapshot.
Kalshi buckets from historical settled markets are post_settlement_market, not contemporaneous open state.
d0_0900 remains structurally unpaired under the frozen method.
A reconstructed paired score is HISTORICAL_REPLAY_DIAGNOSTIC only.
